content_html:
Traveling by train is the most comfortable, safe, and popular way to reach Machu Picchu. The journey passes through breathtaking landscapes of the Sacred Valley and follows the Urubamba River until arriving at Machu Picchu Town (Aguas Calientes).

Currently, there are two authorized companies operating tourist trains to Machu Picchu, offering different services to suit all types of travelers.

Essential Information About Trains to Machu Picchu

Main route: Cusco / Sacred Valley – Machu Picchu Town
Most-used station: Ollantaytambo
⏱ Travel time: Approx. 1 hour 30 minutes
Final destination: Aguas Calientes

From Aguas Calientes, you take a bus ride of 25–30 minutes to reach the entrance of Machu Picchu.

Train Companies to Machu Picchu

PeruRail

The most well-known railway company, with the highest frequency of daily departures.

Departure stations:

  • Poroy (Cusco – dry season only)
  • Ollantaytambo (Sacred Valley)

Available services:

  • Expedition: economical and comfortable option
  • Vistadome: panoramic windows and onboard snack
  • Vistadome Observatory / 360°: panoramic car with open-air balcony
  • Hiram Bingham: luxury train with gourmet dining and live music

Ideal for travelers seeking anything from budget-friendly to luxury experiences.

Inca Rail

A modern company offering comfortable trains and excellent service.

Departure station:

  • Ollantaytambo (includes transportation from Cusco on some services)

Available services:

  • The Voyager: economical and comfortable
  • The 360°: panoramic views and semi-open carriage
  • First Class: spacious seating and included meals
  • The Private: exclusive service for private groups

Perfect for travelers who value comfort and quality service.

Best Time to Travel to Machu Picchu by Train

April – October (Dry Season)

Stable weather and clear skies
Best views during the journey
More train departures available

Book in advance, especially between May and September.

Rainy Season

November – March

Occasional rainfall
Greener landscapes
Fewer tourists

Trains operate normally, but schedules may vary.
